title: ジャパンCの後に・そして、タイマンへ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon wins the Japan Cup. Narita Brian may have lost the race, but she hasn't lost the fight in her yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon tells Narita Brian that she's the only person who can match her as an opponent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian, having chased after her sister's shadow for so long, now turns her focus to Hishi Amazon. She won't relinquish the Arima Kinen to her—and that's a promise.
